Alex G: Heads-up — ran the metric-led routing smoke test on staging and hit a weird SDK mismatch. Some requests get routed to the low-cost variant but our console shows zero routing metrics for that variant. anyone seen this?
Marta P: @Alex G hmm, can you paste the exact request headers you used? could be header normalization.
Alex G: sure. i used the new x-route-meta header that the platform added: `X-Route-Meta: variant=low_cost;trace=smoke-722`
Samir K: we recently changed SDKs to lowercase headers for canonicalization. console and routing infra expect Pascal-style header names. that could explain it.
Irene L: ack. so SDK sends `x-route-meta` and the routing policy service is matching on `X-Route-Meta` exactly? that sounds brittle.
Samir K: right. short-term fix: we can make routing infra do case-insensitive lookup. long-term: align SDK header serialization.
Alex G: i can repro with a tiny curl: ```bash\ncurl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Route-Meta: variant=low_cost;trace=smoke-722" \n https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\n```
Marta P: thanks. @Samir are we sure console's ingestion pipeline isn't normalizing header keys away before it attributes metrics? console expects `route_variant` dimension from header-parsing lambda.
Samir K: console ingestion reads a normalized map, but the policy router emits a telemetry event that includes the matched header key. if router doesn't see the header (because it was lowercased earlier), it falls back and emits variant=default. console then indexes default and low_cost shows nothing.
Irene L: ops-bot: created incident 7222 - routing-metrics-smoke-test-mismatch (P3).
ops-bot: incident 7222 created by Irene L. responders: eng-oncall, eng-platform.
Marta P: plan options: 1) make router lookup case-insensitive (fast, server-side), 2) patch SDKs to emit Pascal-cased headers (py/ts/go patch release), 3) add a normalization shim in the edge proxy to duplicate keys.
Alex G: opinion: do 1 + 2. quick router fix reduces immediate pain; SDK patch prevents recurrence.
Samir K: agree. router change is trivial: switch from map[header] to casefolded lookup. but need a small canary to avoid surprising behavior for custom header patterns.
Irene L: console folks will want to reindex or backfill for the last 24h of staging runs. i'll open a console ticket.
Marta P: SDK break risk: patching py/ts header casing may break clients that intentionally relied on lowercase keys. we should feature-flag the new serialization and default it off for one release.
Samir K: good call. SDK approach: add env var REDWOOD_HEADER_STYLE=pascal|lower|preserve and default to preserve for one minor, then change default. small code snippet for python: ```python\nstyle = os.getenv('REDWOOD_HEADER_STYLE', 'preserve')\nkey = 'X-Route-Meta' if style == 'pascal' else 'x-route-meta'\nheaders[key] = value\n```
Marta P: TS snippet too: ```ts\nconst style = process.env.REDWOOD_HEADER_STYLE || 'preserve';\nconst key = style === 'pascal' ? 'X-Route-Meta' : 'x-route-meta';\nheaders[key] = value;\n```
Alex G: i'll run another smoke after the router patch is deployed to canary and post the traces.
Irene L: can we also add an observability assertion in the smoke harness that fails if variant metrics don't match routing logs? reduces flakiness next time.
Samir K: yes — add a quick check: compare router-decided-variant in trace events vs console-indexed metric for the same trace id. if mismatch, fail.
Marta P: timeline proposal: router case-insensitive lookup rolled to canary in 2 hours, env-flag SDK patch PRs opened today and cut a release candidate tomorrow, console backfill ticket created now.
Alex G: sounds good. thanks everyone. i'll leave the smoke running and ping when green. :thumbsup:
Irene L: thanks @Alex G and @Samir. looping in eng-platform for postmortem if we find edge cases.
ops-bot: deploy to canary started (deploy-8921)
ops-bot: deploy to canary succeeded (deploy-8921)
Alex G: canary looks promising — router now matches both header cases and console shows low_cost variant appearing. re-running full smoke.
Marta P: awesome. when SDK PRs are ready tag devex for a docs blurb about header migration and the env flag.
Samir K: will do. closing incident 7222 once smoke passes.
